datasets.title: Statement of operations
datasets.description: Annual and half-year P&L lines in US$ millions from the S-1 summary consolidated financial data and non-GAAP table.

datasets.title: Quarterly revenue
datasets.description: Quarterly revenue in US$ millions: Q4 2024 from S-1 risk factors, Q1 2025-Q2 2026 from the S-1 quarterly table, Q3 2026 as reported by FT/Reuters (S-1 states it as 86x Q4 2024).

datasets.title: Compute efficiency by quarter
datasets.description: Compute and infrastructure expense (US$ M) and revenue per compute dollar, from S-1 quarterly percentages as reported by Yahoo Finance and ZeroHedge.

datasets.title: Operating income by period
datasets.description: GAAP operating income in US$ millions; Q1 2026 derived as H1 2026 less Q2 2026.

datasets.title: Cloud marketplace channel
datasets.description: Share of revenue and of net receivables through AWS, Google Cloud and Azure marketplaces.

datasets.title: Consumption vs subscription
datasets.description: H1 2026 revenue by pricing model in US$ millions.

datasets.title: $100K+ customers over time
datasets.description: Customers with $100K+ trailing-12-month revenue (Dec 2023 figure as reported).

datasets.title: Key S-1 metrics
datasets.description: Point-in-time metrics (customers, NRR, cash, capital, concentration, governance, SBC, share prices) plus Q3 2026 revenue as reported to investors.

datasets.title: Headcount and productivity
datasets.description: Employee count and TTM revenue per employee (US$ M).

datasets.title: Personnel and SBC
datasets.description: Personnel expense and stock-based compensation in US$ millions.

datasets.title: Compute commitments
datasets.description: Commitments by counterparty in US$ billions from S-1 MD&A; Google TPU 2028-31 (low end of $125-150B) and AMD are company estimates outside the contractual table.

datasets.title: Valuation reference points
datasets.description: Series H post-money (May 2026) and press-reported IPO valuation marks, US$ billions.

datasets.title: Sample risk assessment
datasets.description: Ten risks from the S-1 risk factors with likelihood and impact scored 1-5 as an analyst judgment.

datasets.title: Sample product priorities
datasets.description: Top-5 product priorities ranked as an analyst judgment; supporting figures from the S-1.

datasets.title: Competitor snapshot
datasets.description: Press-reported scale and valuation for direct competitors, with threat level and positioning as analyst judgment.

datasets.title: Sample forecast assumptions
datasets.description: Scenario assumptions (not company guidance): Q4 2026 revenue (US$ M), FY2027/FY2028 growth, FY2028 operating margin, probability.

datasets.title: Co-founder shareholdings
datasets.description: Class A shares beneficially owned by each co-founder at Sep 30, 2026 (post 10-for-1 split).

datasets.title: Cap table and control facts
datasets.description: Public Benefit Fund grant, Amazon/Google ownership caps, Class F/Class A voting power, board and trustee seats, preferred liquidation preference.

datasets.title: Funding rounds
datasets.description: Original issue price of each round's voting preferred series and total liquidation preference per round (US$ M).

datasets.title: Board and executive officers
datasets.description: Directors and officers with age, start date, electing class, committees and background.

datasets.title: Long-Term Benefit Trust trustees
datasets.description: LTBT trustees, start dates and backgrounds; one of five seats vacant.

datasets.title: Executive compensation 2025
datasets.description: Summary Compensation Table for named executive officers, US$.
